Full Stack Developer

Tel Aviv · Full-time · R&D

About the role

We are building the delivery management platform used by furniture retailers to schedule and track last-mile deliveries. You will own features end to end, from the API to the React dashboard our customers use every day.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a full stack developer
  • Strong JavaScript skills and hands-on experience with React
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs with Node.js
  • Hands-on experience with SQL databases
  • Advantage: experience integrating third-party APIs and working with AI tools in development
